items.source: Use the element at the index number evaluated from the given AggregationExpression.

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated array and returns the element at the specified array position.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收关联的数组并返回指定位置的元素。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated array and returns the element at the position defined by the referenced field.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收关联的数组，并返回由引用字段定义的位置处的元素。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated array and returns the element at the position resulting form the given expression.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收关联数组作为参数，并返回由给定表达式计算得出的位置处的元素。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Use the element with given index number.
items.translation: 使用给定索引号的元素。

items.source: Use the element at the index number taken from the given field.
items.translation: 使用给定字段中索引号对应的元素。
